title: WorkflowDiagramsMetadata
description: Shared zip/directory contract for Temporal workflow diagram packages. Language extractors write this as workflow-diagrams-metadata.json alongside one *.mermaid file per workflow. The dashboard UI consumes this format regardless of source language.

packageName.description: Primary package / project identity. Do not use assemblyName when writing new packages.

packagePath.description: Optional path to the scanned package or project root.

language.description: Source language of the workflows that produced this package.

targetFramework.description: Optional runtime / SDK target (e.g. node20, go1.22, jdk17, python3.11).

buildDateUtc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the diagrams were generated.

generator.description: Extractor identity and version, e.g. workflow-diagramming-typescript/0.1.0.

workflows.description: One entry per emitted Mermaid diagram.

diagramFile.description: Relative filename of the Mermaid diagram inside the package (e.g. OrderWorkflow.mermaid).
